note: Empirical dielectric loss factor of this work: linear regression of log10(eps'') on log10(VO_total), i.e. eps'' = 10^a * VO^b with a = -3.07028 +/- 0.695 and b = 1.22355 +/- 0.2302 (OriginLab, no weighting, N = 4, Pearson r 0.96637, R^2 0.93388, adj. R^2 0.90082, RSS 0.18029). Fitted over roughly 95-5000 umol-O/g; below that range the value is an extrapolation and the card marks it. Set eps_prime to display tan delta.
provenance: Measured in this work (Kwak et al.): dielectric loss factor vs total oxygen-vacancy content from H2O-integration titration of reduced rutile.
